0022600229.text: The Mavericks (7-4, 8th in the West) visit the Timberwolves (8-3, 5th in the West) for Dallas's 12th game of the season, with both teams having played 11 games so far. Dallas is 3rd in the Southwest, 2.5 games back, has won three straight, and is 7-3 over its last ten, while Minnesota, 2nd in the Northwest, has won four straight and is also 7-3 over its last ten. Dallas is missing Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain), and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), and Morez Johnson Jr. is day-to-day with a lower leg bruise and is a game-time decision, while Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery). The teams have not met yet this season, and in 2025-26 the Mavericks lost the series 0-4, including a 124-94 loss in Dallas on March 30, 2026.
